name: cycle
description: Two-year election cycle the entry refers to
observations: Partition column

name: recipient_id
description: Unique identifier of the candidate or committee, assigned by DIME
observations: Stable across cycles, offices and levels of government; joins to the contribution table

name: contributor_id
description: Identifier of the same person in the contributor database
observations: Links a candidate to their own personal contributions. Partially populated: a missing value does not mean the candidate made no contributions

name: election
description: Election cycle prefixed by the two-letter state code
observations: Federal candidates take 'fd' as the state code, for example fd1980

name: icpsr_id
description: Adjusted ICPSR legislator identifier with the election cycle appended
observations: Row identifier. Candidates who never served in Congress get identifiers derived from their FEC, NIMSP or state agency candidate identifier

name: icpsr2_id
description: Adjusted ICPSR legislator identifier without the cycle suffix
observations: Party switchers are assigned a new value after switching

name: candidate_id
description: Candidate identifier assigned by the FEC or the state reporting agency

name: fec_committee_id
description: Committee identifier assigned by the FEC or the state reporting agency

name: nimsp_id
description: Candidate identifier assigned by CRP/NIMSP

name: icpsr_id_before_switch
description: ICPSR identifier held before switching parties
observations: Populated for party switchers only

name: icpsr_id_after_switch
description: ICPSR identifier held after switching parties
observations: Populated for party switchers only

name: fec_year
description: Year of the election the campaign targets, as listed by the FEC
observations: Can be later than the cycle, as for senators fundraising during their first four years in office

name: name
description: Name of the candidate or committee

name: last_name
description: Last name of the candidate

name: first_name
description: First name of the candidate

name: middle_name
description: Middle name of the candidate
observations: The source codebook mislabels this field as the first name

name: full_first_name
description: First name, middle name, suffix and title of the candidate concatenated

name: title
description: Title of the candidate
observations: For example Mr., Mrs., Dr., Esq.

name: suffix
description: Name suffix of the candidate

name: candidate_gender
description: Gender of the candidate
observations: Imputed for all candidates except those who served in Congress. Four rows carry the value with literal quote marks, an escaping artefact left in the source

name: party
description: Party of the candidate or committee

name: party_original
description: Party held before a party switch
observations: Populated for party switchers only

name: state
description: Two-letter state abbreviation of the candidate or committee
observations: Not linked to the state directory because it includes non-state codes

name: seat
description: Office sought by the candidate
observations: Committees are listed as federal:committee or state:committee

name: district
description: District code of the seat sought
observations: Two-letter state code followed by the district number; Senate candidates take 'S' followed by the year the seat is up

name: district_cycle
description: District and cycle the candidate contested
observations: For example 1980_MS_S

name: incumbency_status
description: Incumbency status of the candidate

name: recipient_cfscore
description: Common-space CFscore of the recipient
observations: Ideal point estimated from donations received; negative is liberal, positive is conservative. Constant across cycles for a recipient

name: recipient_cfscore_dynamic
description: Cycle-specific CFscore of the recipient
observations: Re-estimated each cycle holding contributor scores constant

name: contributor_cfscore
description: CFscore of the recipient estimated from their own personal donations

name: dw_dime
description: DW-DIME score of the recipient
observations: Roll-call score inferred from contributions by supervised machine learning (Bonica 2018)

name: composite_score
description: Composite ideological score of the recipient
observations: Combines contributions, roll-call votes and other sources by multiple overimputation; new in version 4.0

name: dw_nominate_1
description: First-dimension common-space DW-NOMINATE score
observations: From voteview.com, based on a joint scaling of the 1st to 117th Congresses

name: dw_nominate_2
description: Second-dimension common-space DW-NOMINATE score
observations: From voteview.com

name: dw_nominate_1_period
description: First-dimension Nokken-Poole period-specific DW-NOMINATE score
observations: From voteview.com. House and Senate are scaled separately, so the two chambers are not directly comparable

name: dw_nominate_2_period
description: Second-dimension Nokken-Poole period-specific DW-NOMINATE score
observations: From voteview.com

name: irt_cfscore
description: Ideal point of the recipient from an IRT count model applied to PAC data
observations: See Bonica (2013)

name: number_of_givers
description: Number of distinct donors who gave to the recipient during the cycle

name: number_of_givers_total
description: Number of distinct donors who gave to the recipient over their whole career

name: total_receipts
description: Total contributions raised during the cycle
observations: Nominal dollars

name: total_disbursements
description: Total campaign disbursements during the cycle
observations: Nominal dollars

name: total_individual_contributions
description: Total itemized contributions from individuals raised during the cycle
observations: Nominal dollars

name: total_unitemized
description: Total unitemized contributions from individuals raised during the cycle
observations: Nominal dollars

name: total_pac_contributions
description: Total raised from PACs and other committees during the cycle
observations: Nominal dollars

name: total_party_contributions
description: Total raised from party committees during the cycle
observations: Nominal dollars

name: total_contributions_from_candidate
description: Total raised from the candidate's own contributions during the cycle
observations: Nominal dollars

name: independent_expenditure_support
description: Total independent expenditures made to support the candidate
observations: Nominal dollars

name: independent_expenditure_oppose
description: Total independent expenditures made to oppose the candidate
observations: Nominal dollars

name: primary_vote_share
description: Vote share won in the primary election, as reported by the FEC
observations: Coded for federal congressional candidates only

name: primary_winner
description: Outcome of the primary election
observations: Coded for federal congressional candidates only

name: general_vote_share
description: Vote share won in the general election, as reported by the FEC

name: general_winner
description: Outcome of the general election
observations: Federal outcomes come from the FEC, state outcomes from NIMSP

name: special_election_status
description: Outcome of the special election, as coded by the FEC
observations: The source uses '?' for an unrecorded outcome, which is kept rather than nulled

name: runoff_election_status
description: Outcome of the run-off election, as coded by the FEC
observations: The source uses '?' for an unrecorded outcome, which is kept rather than nulled

name: district_presidential_vote_share
description: Two-party vote share won by the Democratic presidential nominee in the district
observations: Measured at the most recent or concurrent presidential election

name: fec_candidate_status
description: Status of the candidate's campaign as assigned by the FEC

name: recipient_type
description: Whether the recipient is a candidate or a committee

name: interest_group_category
description: FEC interest group category of the committee

name: committee_type
description: FEC code for the type of committee

name: included_in_scaling
description: Whether the recipient met the requirements for inclusion in the CFscore estimation
observations: Stored as 0 or 1 in the source. Recipients with value 0 are absent from the smaller dime_recipients file

name: nimsp_party
description: Party name assigned by NIMSP
observations: Spelled-out party names, not codes, and not normalized at source: DEMOCRATIC and DEMOCRAT both occur

name: nimsp_incumbency_status
description: Incumbency status assigned by NIMSP

name: nimsp_district
description: District number assigned by NIMSP

name: nimsp_office
description: State office sought, as coded by NIMSP

name: nimsp_candidate_status
description: Election outcome as recorded by NIMSP
observations: Readable phrases, not normalized at source: both 'Lost - General Election' and 'Lost-General' occur
